items.title: 关联结构 the more...the more 与 no sooner...than
items.brief: 比较级成对前置，no sooner 后接 than 并倒装

concept.summary: 这两个结构都靠固定框架识别：the more..., the more... 要求两个分句都以 the + 比较级开头，表示两个变化量成正比；no sooner...than 表示“刚…就…”，主句用过去完成时，从句用一般过去时，no sooner 置于句首时主句必须部分倒装。框架缺一个 the、连接词换成 when、或忘记倒装，句子即错。

sections.h: the + 比较级，the + 比较级
sections.p: 两个分句的 the 都是框架的一部分，一个都不能省，且比较级必须紧跟 the。前一分句相当于条件，用一般现在时；后一分句表结果，用 will、情态动词或一般现在时。比较级本身不能再加 more。
bullets: The more you read, the faster your reading speed becomes.
The earlier you start, the more likely you are to finish on time.
× The more you read, more you will learn.（第二个 the 缺失）
× The more you eat, the more fatter you get.（more 与 -er 重复）

sections.h: no sooner...than 的时态与倒装
sections.p: no sooner 引出的动作先发生，用过去完成时；than 从句的动作随后发生，用一般过去时。no sooner 位于句首时，把 had 提到主语之前构成部分倒装；no sooner 留在句中则用正常语序。同义的 hardly/scarcely 搭配 when，不搭配 than。
bullets: No sooner had the bell rung than the students rushed out.
He had no sooner arrived than it began to rain.
× No sooner he had arrived than it began to rain.（句首未倒装）
Hardly had she sat down when the phone rang.

sections.p: the more 结构可以省略主语和 be 动词，形成 the more, the better 这类紧缩表达；也可以只重复比较级而省略整个分句。no sooner 不能与表示持续的时间段连用，因为它标记的是两个瞬间动作的紧接。
bullets: The more, the better.
The more carefully you plan, the fewer mistakes you will make.
The sooner, the better.（越早越好）
× No sooner had he lived there for ten years than he moved away.

examples.en: The more carefully you plan, the fewer mistakes you will make.
examples.zh: 你计划得越仔细，犯的错误就越少。
examples.note: 两个分句都以 the + 比较级开头，前句表条件，后句表结果。

examples.en: The more you practice, more confident you will become.
examples.zh: 你练习得越多，就会越自信。
examples.note: 第二个分句缺少 the，the + 比较级 的框架必须两处齐全。

examples.en: No sooner had she finished the report than the manager asked for it.
examples.zh: 她刚写完报告，经理就来要了。
examples.note: no sooner 置于句首，主句用过去完成时并部分倒装，从句用一般过去时。

examples.en: No sooner she had finished the report than the manager asked for it.
examples.zh: 她刚写完报告，经理就来要了。
examples.note: no sooner 位于句首时必须倒装，应改为 No sooner had she finished。

examples.en: The harder you work, the more you will achieve.
examples.zh: 你越努力，取得的成就就越大。
examples.note: 前后两个比较级分句成对出现，the 均不可省。

examples.en: Hardly had he arrived than the meeting began.
examples.zh: 他刚到会议就开始了。
examples.note: hardly 后接 when 而不是 than；than 只与 no sooner 搭配。

examples.en: The more, the better.
examples.zh: 越多越好。
examples.note: 省略主语与谓语的紧缩形式，两个 the 仍然保留。

pitfalls.wrong: No sooner had the train left when we arrived at the station.
pitfalls.right: No sooner had the train left than we arrived at the station.
pitfalls.why: no sooner 的固定后接词是 than；when 属于 hardly/scarcely 的搭配，两者不能互换。

pitfalls.wrong: The more you eat, the more fatter you become.
pitfalls.right: The more you eat, the fatter you become.
pitfalls.why: 比较级不能双重标记，more 与 -er 只能取其一。

pitfalls.wrong: No sooner he had got home than the phone rang.
pitfalls.right: No sooner had he got home than the phone rang.
pitfalls.why: 句首的 no sooner 属于否定性副词，要求主句部分倒装，助动词 had 必须前置。

contrast.diff: the more...the more 是两个变化量的正比关系，必须成对出现；比较级表最高级是单一比较结构在特定范围内的替换用法。

concept.mnemonic: the 字成对，比较级紧跟；no sooner 配 than，主句过去完成加倒装；hardly 配 when。

core: the more..., the more...：两个分句都必须 the + 比较级，the 不能省
前句用一般现在时表条件，后句用 will 或情态动词表结果
no sooner...than：主句过去完成时，从句一般过去时
no sooner 置于句首，主句部分倒装：No sooner had he left than...
hardly/scarcely...when 与 no sooner...than 的连接词不能互换
比较级不能 more + -er 双重标记
review.trigger: 看到句首 the + 比较级或 no sooner/hardly → 先补全 the 框架，再查倒装与时态

quickCheck.q: “你越早出发，到得越早”用哪个框架？
quickCheck.a: The earlier you set off, the sooner you will arrive.

quickCheck.q: No sooner 位于句首时主句怎么变？
quickCheck.a: 部分倒装，把 had 提到主语前：No sooner had he left...

quickCheck.q: Hardly 后面接 than 还是 when？

drills.stem: ___ you start, the sooner you will finish the whole project.
drills.answer: The earlier
drills.explain: 该结构要求 the + 比较级 开头，early 的比较级是 earlier，且 the 不能省略。
drills.trap: Earlier 缺少 the，框架不完整；The more early 是 more 与 -er 的双重比较错误。

drills.stem: No sooner ___ the lights gone out than the audience burst into applause.
drills.answer: had
drills.hint: no sooner 位于句首，助动词要提前；注意后面用的是 gone。
drills.explain: no sooner 置于句首要求部分倒装，主句用过去完成时，助动词 had 提到主语 the lights 之前。

drills.stem: No sooner she had opened the door than the cat ran out.
drills.answer: No sooner had she opened the door than the cat ran out.
accept: No sooner had she opened the door than the cat ran out.
drills.explain: no sooner 位于句首时必须部分倒装，把助动词 had 从主语 she 之后移到之前。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The more carefully you plan, the fewer mistakes you will make.
drills.explain: 两个分句都采用 the + 比较级 开头，前句表条件，后句用 will 表结果。

drills.stem: 你练习得越多，说英语就越自信。
drills.answer: The more you practice speaking English, the more confident you will become.
forbid: the more you practice, more confident
drills.explain: 两个分句都要有 the + 比较级，confident 的比较级用 more confident，不能再加 -er。

drills.stem: Hardly ___ the classroom when it started to snow heavily.
drills.answer: had we entered
drills.explain: hardly...when 表示“刚…就…”，主句用过去完成时，hardly 置于句首时部分倒装，had 提到主语前。
drills.trap: did we enter 只完成了倒装，却没有体现动作在先的过去完成时；we had entered 则漏掉倒装。

items.title: 惯用句型 It is ... that 与 There is no denying that
items.brief: 删掉框架做完整性测试，判定强调句或形式主语

concept.summary: It is ... that 有两种身份，判定方法是删掉 It is 与 that 后看剩余部分是否仍是完整句子：完整则是强调句，不完整则是 It 作形式主语、that 从句作真正主语。There is no denying/point/sense 属于存在句的评价结构，deny 必须以动名词 denying 出现，point/sense 后接 (in) doing，不能接 to do。

sections.h: 删框架测试：强调句还是形式主语
sections.p: 强调句可以强调主语、宾语和状语，被强调部分放在 It is 之后，其余成分由 that 引出；删掉框架后句子成分齐全。形式主语句删掉框架后，that 从句本身就是完整句子，It 只是占位，没有词汇意义。
bullets: It was in 2019 that they moved to Chengdu.（强调状语，删框架后仍完整）
It is important that everyone arrives on time.（形式主语，that 从句是真正主语）
× It is important is that everyone arrives on time.
强调人时连接词可用 who：It was Mary who broke the window.

sections.h: There is no denying that 类结构
sections.p: there be 后接名词性成分，deny 是动词，必须先变成动名词 denying 才能占据这个位置。同类结构还有 There is no doubt that...、There is no need to do、There is no point/sense (in) doing，各自的后续形式固定。
bullets: There is no denying that the plan has serious flaws.
There is no point (in) arguing about it now.
There is no need to apologize.
× There is no deny that the plan has serious flaws.

sections.h: It is no use / It is time 类固定句式
sections.p: It is no use/no good doing sth 中 it 是形式主语，真正主语是动名词短语，不能换成不定式。It is (high) time that 从句用一般过去时或 should + 动词原形，表示“早该做某事了”。It is said/reported that 可转换为 sb/sth is said to do。
bullets: It is no use crying over spilt milk.
It is high time that we took action.
× It is no use to cry over spilt milk.
It is said that he lives abroad. = He is said to live abroad.

examples.en: It was at the railway station that they first met.
examples.zh: 他们第一次见面就是在这个火车站。
examples.note: 强调地点状语，删去 It was 与 that 后 they first met at the railway station 仍完整。

examples.en: It was at the railway station where they first met.
examples.zh: 他们第一次见面就是在这个火车站。
examples.note: 强调句的连接词固定用 that，where 会把结构变成定语从句，句子因此不成立。

examples.en: There is no denying that reading widely improves writing.
examples.zh: 不可否认，广泛阅读能提高写作水平。
examples.note: denying 是动名词，作 there be 的名词性成分，后接 that 从句。

examples.en: There is no deny that reading widely improves writing.
examples.zh: 不可否认，广泛阅读能提高写作水平。
examples.note: deny 是动词，不能直接作 there be 的表语名词，须改为 denying。

examples.en: It is no use complaining about the weather.
examples.zh: 抱怨天气没有用。
examples.note: it 为形式主语，真正主语是动名词短语 complaining about the weather。

examples.en: It is no use to complain about the weather.
examples.zh: 抱怨天气没有用。
examples.note: no use 后固定接动名词，不能换成不定式。

examples.en: It is high time that we started to prepare for the exam.
examples.zh: 我们早该开始准备考试了。
examples.note: It is high time that 从句用一般过去时表虚拟。

pitfalls.wrong: It was in the library where I found the book.
pitfalls.right: It was in the library that I found the book.
pitfalls.why: 强调句的连接词固定为 that，where 只用于修饰地点先行词的定语从句。

pitfalls.wrong: There is no point to discuss the matter again.
pitfalls.right: There is no point in discussing the matter again.
pitfalls.why: point 后接 in + 动名词，in 可以省略，但动词必须用 -ing 形式。

pitfalls.wrong: It is no good to stay up late before an exam.
pitfalls.right: It is no good staying up late before an exam.
pitfalls.why: no good/no use 后用动名词作真正主语，形式主语 it 不能带不定式。

contrast.diff: it 的固定句型按词条记搭配（It takes sb... / It is worth...）；本知识点解决同一外壳下“形式主语”与“强调句”的身份判定。

concept.mnemonic: 删掉 It is 和 that，句子还站得住就是强调句；no use/no good 后面只跟 doing。

core: 强调句：去掉 It is ... that 后句子仍完整，连接词只能是 that（人可用 who）
形式主语：that 从句是真正主语，It 没有词汇意义
There is no denying/point/sense (in) doing，deny 必须用 denying
It is no use/no good doing sth，不能接 to do
It is (high) time that sb did / should do
It is said that sb... = sb is said to...
review.trigger: 看到 It is ... that → 先删框架做完整性测试；看到 no use/no good/point → 后面填 doing

quickCheck.q: It was in 2019 that they met. 是强调句还是形式主语？
quickCheck.a: 强调句，删掉框架后 they met in 2019 完整。

quickCheck.q: There is no denying 后面为什么用 denying？
quickCheck.a: there be 后需要名词性成分，deny 必须变为动名词。

quickCheck.q: It is no use 后接 to do 还是 doing？

drills.stem: It was not until midnight ___ the firefighters brought the fire under control.
drills.answer: that
drills.explain: not until 的强调结构固定为 It was not until ... that ...，that 引出剩余部分。
drills.trap: when 会让人误以为这里是时间状语从句，但句首已有 It was not until 的强调框架，连接词只能是 that。

drills.stem: There is no ___ (deny) that the new policy has helped small businesses.
drills.answer: denying
drills.hint: there be 后需要名词性成分，括号里的动词要先变形式。
drills.explain: there be 后不能直接放动词原形，deny 须变为动名词 denying 才能作名词性成分。

drills.stem: It is no use to argue with him about the schedule.
drills.answer: It is no use arguing with him about the schedule.
accept: It is no use arguing with him about the schedule.
drills.explain: It is no use 后接动名词作真正主语，it 只是形式主语，不能带不定式。

drills.stem: It is high time that we ___ the final decision.
drills.answer: made
drills.explain: It is high time that 从句用一般过去时表示与现在事实相反的虚拟，故用 made。
drills.trap: make 是陈述语气，会把“早该做”的虚拟含义变成普通陈述。

drills.stem: 毫无疑问，定期锻炼有益健康。
drills.answer: There is no doubt that regular exercise is good for health.
drills.explain: There is no doubt that 是固定存在句结构，that 引导同位语性质的从句说明 doubt 的内容。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: It is no use complaining about the weather.
drills.explain: It 为形式主语，真正主语是动名词短语 complaining about the weather；no use 后不能接不定式。

items.title: 动词的固定句型
items.brief: 看宾语是否为动作执行者，决定 to do 还是 doing

concept.summary: 动词句型由两个变量决定：动词词条本身接 to do 还是 doing，以及宾语是不是后面动作的执行者。若宾语执行后面的动作，用 sb to do；使役与感官动词用 sb do，变被动后省略的 to 要还原。suggest/insist/demand 类不接 sb to do，只能接 that 从句或动名词。

sections.p: 这类动词的补语形式属于词条属性，必须整体记忆，换形式即错。判断时不要从汉语意思推导，直接查该动词属于哪一组。
bullets: 只接 to do：decide, hope, manage, refuse, offer, afford, promise, fail
只接 doing：enjoy, mind, avoid, suggest, consider, practice, admit, deny
× He suggested to postpone the meeting. → He suggested postponing the meeting.
× She avoided to answer the question. → She avoided answering the question.

sections.h: 带宾语时看动作执行者
sections.p: 若宾语是后面动作的执行者，用 sb to do；若宾语只是动作的承受者、后面没有第二个动作，则按动词自身词条接 to do 或 doing。使役与感官动词接 sb do，主动语态省 to，被动语态必须还原 to。
bullets: advise/allow/permit/persuade/remind/force/encourage/warn + sb to do
make/let/have/see/hear/watch/notice + sb do
He was made to apologize.（被动还原 to）
× He advised me going there. → He advised me to go there.

sections.p: suggest/insist/demand/require/recommend 表示“建议、要求”的内容时，用 that 从句（should 可省）或动名词，不能接 sb to do。think/find/make/consider + it + adj + to do 中 it 是形式宾语，真正宾语是后面的不定式。
bullets: She suggested that we (should) start earlier.
× She suggested us to start earlier.
I find it hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
It takes me an hour to get to work.

examples.en: She suggested postponing the meeting until Friday.
examples.zh: 她建议把会议推迟到周五。
examples.note: suggest 后接动名词，不能接不定式。

examples.en: She suggested to postpone the meeting until Friday.
examples.zh: 她建议把会议推迟到周五。
examples.note: suggest 只接动名词或 that 从句，不能接 to do。

examples.en: The teacher advised us to check our answers twice.
examples.zh: 老师建议我们把答案检查两遍。
examples.note: advise 带宾语 us，us 是 check 的执行者，故用 to do。

examples.en: The teacher advised us checking our answers twice.
examples.zh: 老师建议我们把答案检查两遍。
examples.note: advise 带宾语时须用 to do，不能用 doing。

examples.en: The boss made him redo the whole report.
examples.zh: 老板让他把整份报告重做。
examples.note: make + sb + 动词原形，主动语态省略 to。

examples.en: He was made to redo the whole report.
examples.zh: 他被要求把整份报告重做。
examples.note: 变为被动后，主动语态省略的 to 必须还原。

examples.en: She suggested us to leave early.
examples.zh: 她建议我们早点离开。
examples.note: suggest 不能接 sb to do，应改为 suggested that we leave early。

pitfalls.wrong: They forced him staying in the office.
pitfalls.right: They forced him to stay in the office.
pitfalls.why: force 带宾语时用 to do，him 是 stay 的执行者，不能用动名词。

pitfalls.wrong: He suggested me to apply for the scholarship.
pitfalls.right: He suggested that I apply for the scholarship.
pitfalls.why: suggest 不接双宾语结构，建议的内容由 that 从句或动名词承担。

pitfalls.wrong: The boy was made clean the classroom.
pitfalls.right: The boy was made to clean the classroom.
pitfalls.why: make 变被动后，主动语态中省略的 to 必须还原。

contrast.diff: 本知识点按“动词词条 + 宾语角色”成组记句型；不定式章节按句法功能讲 to do 能充当什么成分。

concept.mnemonic: enjoy/mind/avoid 只跟 doing；advise/allow/persuade 带人加 to do；make/let/see 带人用原形，被动补 to；suggest 后面不接人。

core: 只接 to do：decide/hope/manage/refuse/offer/afford
只接 doing：enjoy/mind/avoid/suggest/consider/practice/admit/deny
宾语是动作执行者 → sb to do：advise/allow/persuade/remind/force
使役与感官动词 → sb do，变被动后还原 to
suggest/insist/demand 不接 sb to do，用 that 从句或 doing
find/think/make + it + adj + to do，it 为形式宾语
review.trigger: 看到动词后既有人又有动作 → 先问“这个人做后面的动作吗” → 是则 sb to do，否则查词条

quickCheck.q: suggest 后面能说 suggest sb to do 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不能，用 suggest that sb (should) do 或 suggest doing。

quickCheck.q: make sb do 变被动后是什么形式？
quickCheck.a: sb be made to do，to 必须还原。

quickCheck.q: avoid 后面接 to do 还是 doing？

drills.stem: They decided ___ the opening ceremony until next month.
drills.answer: to postpone
drills.explain: decide 属于只接不定式的动词，后接 to do，不能接动名词。
drills.trap: postponing 是受 enjoy/mind 类动词类推的错误，decide 不接受动名词作宾语。

drills.stem: She avoided ___ (mention) the incident in front of the children.
drills.answer: mentioning
drills.hint: avoid 属于只接动名词的动词。
drills.explain: avoid 后只能接动名词，mention 须变为 mentioning，不能使用不定式。

drills.stem: The manager suggested us to revise the schedule.
drills.answer: The manager suggested that we revise the schedule.
accept: The manager suggested that we revise the schedule.
The manager suggested revising the schedule.
drills.explain: suggest 不能接 sb to do，建议内容用 that 从句（should 可省）或动名词表达。

drills.stem: The little boy was made ___ his room before dinner.
drills.answer: to tidy
drills.explain: make 用于被动语态时，主动语态中省略的 to 必须还原，构成 be made to do。
drills.trap: tidy 是主动语态 make sb do 的形式，被动语态中不能继续省 to。

drills.stem: 老师建议我们每天大声朗读。
drills.answer: The teacher advised us to read aloud every day.
drills.explain: advise 带宾语时用 sb to do，us 是 read 的执行者；suggest 不能接 sb to do。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: I find it hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
drills.explain: it 是形式宾语，hard 作宾语补足语，真正宾语是后面的不定式 to concentrate。

items.title: 形容词句型 too...to / so...as to / enough to
items.brief: too 含否定结果，enough 的位置随修饰对象变

concept.summary: 三个句型都表示“达到某种程度后产生的结果”，差别在程度词的位置与结果方向：too + adj + to do 表示“太…以致不能”，结果本身已含否定；so + adj + as to do 表示“如此…以至于”，结果中性；adj + enough + to do 表示“足够…能”，结果肯定。enough 修饰形容词时后置，修饰名词时前置。

sections.p: too 后的不定式在语义上被否定，句中不再另加 not。若不定式的宾语与句子主语指同一事物，宾语必须省略，否则重复。too...for sb to do 用来引出不定式的逻辑主语。
bullets: He is too tired to walk any further.（= so tired that he cannot walk）
The box is too heavy for me to carry.
× The box is too heavy for me to carry it.
× He was too excited that he could not say a word.

sections.p: so + adj/adv + as to do 表示结果，句子的主语同时是不定式的逻辑主语；as 不能省。so...that 后接完整从句，such + (a/an) + adj + n + that 的中心词是名词。
bullets: She was so careless as to leave her passport at home.
She was so careless that she left her passport at home.
It was such a cold day that the pipes froze.
× She was so careless to leave her passport at home.

sections.h: enough 的位置与句型转换
sections.p: enough 修饰形容词或副词时后置，修饰名词时前置。enough to do 表肯定结果，可与 too...to、not...enough to 互相改写，改写时形容词的极性要相反。
bullets: He is old enough to make his own decisions.
We have enough time to finish the task.
× He is enough old to drive.
The water is not hot enough to make tea. = The water is too cold to make tea.

examples.en: The suitcase is too heavy for the child to lift.
examples.zh: 这个行李箱太重，孩子提不动。
examples.note: too...for sb to do，lift 后不再重复宾语 the suitcase。

examples.en: The suitcase is too heavy for the child to lift it.
examples.zh: 这个行李箱太重，孩子提不动。
examples.note: 不定式宾语与句子主语重复，it 必须删去。

examples.en: She was so absorbed in the book as to forget her stop.
examples.zh: 她太专注于这本书，以至于坐过了站。
examples.note: so + 形容词 + as to do 表示结果，as 不可省。

examples.en: She was so absorbed in the book to forget her stop.
examples.zh: 她太专注于这本书，以至于坐过了站。
examples.note: so 后表结果必须用 as to，不能直接接 to do。

examples.en: He is experienced enough to handle the negotiation alone.
examples.zh: 他经验足够，可以独自处理这次谈判。
examples.note: enough 修饰形容词时后置。

examples.en: He is enough experienced to handle the negotiation alone.
examples.zh: 他经验足够，可以独自处理这次谈判。
examples.note: enough 修饰形容词必须后置，不能放在形容词前。

examples.en: The room was too small to hold fifty people.
examples.zh: 这个房间太小，容纳不下五十人。
examples.note: too...to 已含否定，句中不再加 not。

pitfalls.wrong: He was too excited that he could not say a word.
pitfalls.right: He was too excited to say a word.
pitfalls.why: too 不能直接接 that 从句；表结果要么用 too...to，要么用 so...that。

pitfalls.wrong: The coffee is not enough hot to drink.
pitfalls.right: The coffee is not hot enough to drink.
pitfalls.why: enough 修饰形容词时必须后置，构成 hot enough。

pitfalls.wrong: She is old enough that she can vote.
pitfalls.right: She is old enough to vote.
pitfalls.why: enough 表结果时接不定式，不接 that 从句。

contrast.withTitle: 结果状语从句 so...that 与 such...that
contrast.diff: so...as to 是短语结构，结果由不定式表达且主语一致；so...that 后接完整从句，从句可以有不同主语。

concept.mnemonic: too 后否定，so 后 as to，enough 形容词后、名词前。

core: too + adj/adv + to do = 太…不能，结果已含否定
too...for sb to do 引出逻辑主语，不定式不再重复宾语
so + adj/adv + as to do 表结果，as 不能省
adj/adv + enough + to do；enough + 名词
too...to 与 not...enough to 可互改，形容词极性相反
so...that 后接完整从句
review.trigger: 看到 too/so/enough 与不定式同现 → 先定程度词位置，再查结果方向与宾语是否重复

quickCheck.q: enough 修饰形容词时放哪里？
too...to 后面还要加 not 吗？
quickCheck.a: 不加，too 本身已含否定结果。

quickCheck.q: so 后接不定式表结果时用什么形式？

drills.stem: The lecture was ___ difficult for the first-year students to follow.
drills.answer: too
drills.explain: too + adj + for sb to do 表示“太…以致某人不能…”，与句意完全吻合。
drills.trap: so 必须与 that 从句或 as to 搭配，不能直接接 for sb to do；enough 表肯定且须后置。

drills.stem: The ice on the lake is not thick ___ to skate on.
drills.answer: enough
drills.hint: 形容词 thick 后面需要程度词，且后面的结果是否定的。
drills.explain: not + adj + enough + to do 表示“不够…而不能…”，enough 修饰形容词时必须后置。

drills.stem: The box was too heavy for the little girl to carry it upstairs.
drills.answer: The box was too heavy for the little girl to carry upstairs.
accept: The box was too heavy for the little girl to carry upstairs.
drills.explain: 不定式 to carry 的宾语就是句子主语 the box，it 重复了指代对象，必须删去。

drills.stem: He was ___ absorbed in his work as to miss the announcement.
drills.answer: so
drills.explain: so + 形容词 + as to do 表示结果，absorbed 是形容词，符合该结构。
drills.trap: too 不能与 as to 构成结果结构；such 只能修饰名词短语，不能直接修饰 absorbed。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She was so careless as to leave her keys at home.
drills.explain: so + 形容词 + as to do 表结果，句子主语 she 同时是不定式的逻辑主语。

drills.stem: 这辆车太小了，坐不下五个人。
drills.answer: The car is too small to hold five people.
forbid: too small to hold five people in it
drills.explain: too + adj + to do 表示“太…而不能…”，hold 的宾语是 five people，不再用 it 重复 the car。

items.title: 名词句型 have difficulty (in) doing

concept.summary: 这类句型的骨架是“名词 + 介词 + 动名词”：have difficulty/trouble/problems (in) doing sth 中 difficulty 表“困难”时不可数，不加 a 也不加 s；in 可以省略，但动词必须是 -ing 形式。同型结构还有 spend/waste time (in) doing、be busy (in) doing、There is no point (in) doing。

sections.p: difficulty 表抽象“困难”时不可数，表“具体难题”时可数。句型中一律用不可数形式；in 是介词，后面只能接动名词，省略 in 不改变动词形式。
bullets: I have difficulty (in) understanding his accent.
× I have difficulty to understand his accent.
× I have a difficulty in understanding his accent.
She described the difficulties she had met.（具体难题，可数）

sections.h: 同型扩展：spend / waste / be busy
sections.p: 这些结构都是“动词 + 时间或状态 + (in) doing”，介词省略后依然是动名词。spend 的宾语是时间或金钱，不是动作本身，因此不能说 spend time to do。
bullets: He spent two hours (in) revising the essay.
× He spent two hours to revise the essay.
She is busy (in) preparing for the interview.
Don't waste time complaining about things you cannot change.

sections.h: there is no point 与 have trouble with
sections.p: point/sense/use 后接 (in) doing；trouble 后接 with + 名词，或 (in) doing，两种结构不能混用。判断依据是空格后是名词还是动作。
bullets: There is no point (in) arguing with him.
I had trouble with the pronunciation of that word.
× I had trouble to pronounce that word.
It is no use crying over spilt milk.

examples.en: Many students have difficulty in organizing their study time.
examples.zh: 许多学生在安排学习时间上有困难。
examples.note: difficulty 不可数，in 后接动名词 organizing。

examples.en: Many students have difficulty to organize their study time.
examples.zh: 许多学生在安排学习时间上有困难。
examples.note: 该句型固定接 (in) doing，不能接 to do。

examples.en: She spent the whole afternoon preparing for the presentation.
examples.zh: 她整个下午都在准备演示。
examples.note: spend + 时间 + (in) doing，in 已省略但动词仍是动名词。

examples.en: She spent the whole afternoon to prepare for the presentation.
examples.zh: 她整个下午都在准备演示。
examples.note: spend 后接动名词，不能接不定式。

examples.en: There is no point in complaining about the result now.
examples.zh: 现在抱怨结果没有意义。
examples.note: point 后接 in doing，in 可以省略。

examples.en: He had trouble with the new software at first.
examples.zh: 他起初对这款新软件不太会用。
examples.note: trouble with + 名词，表示在某事上有困难。

examples.en: I have a difficulty in reading his handwriting.
examples.zh: 我很难辨认他的字迹。
examples.note: 句型中 difficulty 不可数，不能加 a。

pitfalls.wrong: She has difficulty to remember names.
pitfalls.why: difficulty 后的介词 in 常省略，但动词必须用动名词。

pitfalls.wrong: We spent three hours to finish the report.
pitfalls.right: We spent three hours finishing the report.
pitfalls.why: spend + 时间 + (in) doing 是固定结构，to do 不成立。

pitfalls.wrong: There is no point to discuss it further.
pitfalls.right: There is no point in discussing it further.
pitfalls.why: point 后接 in + 动名词，介词不能换成 to。

contrast.withTitle: 介词后接动名词的固定结构
contrast.diff: 介词章节讲“介词 + doing”的普遍规则；本知识点是名词侧的高频句型清单，重点是 difficulty 的可数性与 in 的省略。

concept.mnemonic: difficulty 不可数，后面 doing 不带 to；spend、busy、no point，in 可省 doing 不变。

core: have difficulty/trouble/problems (in) doing sth
difficulty 表困难不可数：不加 a、不加 s
in 可省略，但动词必须是 -ing 形式
spend/waste time (in) doing；be busy (in) doing
There is no point/sense (in) doing
have trouble with + 名词，不能接 to do
review.trigger: 看到 difficulty/trouble/busy/spend 后面跟动作 → 先写 doing，再查 difficulty 前有没有多余的 a

quickCheck.q: “做某事有困难”有哪两种写法？
spend time 后面接 to do 还是 doing？
difficulty 在这个句型里能加 a 吗？

drills.stem: Many freshmen have difficulty ___ used to university life.
drills.answer: getting
drills.explain: have difficulty (in) doing 是固定句型，in 省略后动词仍须用动名词 getting。
drills.trap: to get 是受汉语“很难适应”直译影响的不定式误用，该句型不接受 to do。

drills.stem: She had great difficulty in ___ (find) a quiet place to study.
drills.answer: finding
drills.hint: in 是介词，后面动词用什么形式？
drills.explain: in 是介词，介词后接动名词，find 须变为 finding。

drills.stem: He spent two hours to repair the bicycle.
drills.answer: He spent two hours repairing the bicycle.
accept: He spent two hours repairing the bicycle.
drills.explain: spend + 时间 + (in) doing 是固定结构，to repair 应改为动名词 repairing。

drills.stem: There is no point ___ about the weather before the trip.
drills.answer: in worrying
drills.explain: point 后接 in + 动名词，in 可省略，但动词必须是 -ing 形式。
drills.trap: to worry 把 point 当成可接不定式的名词，实际上 point 后只能接 in doing。

drills.stem: 我在理解这位教授的讲座时有困难。
drills.answer: I have difficulty understanding the professor's lecture.
drills.explain: have difficulty (in) doing 中 difficulty 不可数，动词用动名词 understanding。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She is busy preparing for the job interview.
drills.explain: be busy (in) doing 是固定句型，in 省略后仍用动名词 preparing。
